description: Manages user-defined saved filters, allowing users to store and reuse complex search criteria or data configurations across different parts of the application.

endpoints.name: CreateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Creates a new saved filter for the current user. The request body should contain the details of the filter to be saved, including its name and the filter criteria.

request.description: Filter creation request containing the name and criteria for the new saved filter.

example_uses: Create a new saved filter named 'My Active Projects' with specific project status criteria.
Save a complex search query for partners in a particular region as a new filter.
Can you help me create a saved filter for all interactions from the last quarter?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you want to save a specific set of search criteria or filter configurations for later reuse.

endpoints.name: UpdateSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Updates an existing saved filter. The request body must include the ID of the filter to be updated, along with the new details or modified criteria.

request.description: Filter update request containing the ID of the filter to update and its new details.

example_uses: Update the 'My Active Projects' filter to include a new project type.
Modify the criteria of an existing saved filter to refine its search results.
I need to change the name of my 'Old Interactions' filter to 'Archived Interactions'.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to modify the details or criteria of an already saved filter.

endpoints.name: DeleteSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Deletes a specific saved filter by its unique identifier.

id.description: The unique ID of the saved filter to delete.

example_uses: Delete the saved filter with ID 123.
Remove the 'Temporary Search' filter.
Can you delete the filter I created yesterday?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you no longer need a previously saved filter and wish to remove it.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilter
endpoints.description: Retrieves the details of a single saved filter by its unique ID.

id.description: The unique ID of the saved filter to retrieve.

example_uses: Get the details of saved filter ID 456.
Show me the configuration for the 'High Priority Tasks' filter.
What are the criteria defined in filter number 789?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to view the specific configuration or details of a particular saved filter.

endpoints.name: GetSavedFilters
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all saved filters for the current user, with optional search and pagination capabilities. The `request` parameter allows for advanced filtering using a JSON array of `searchCriteria` objects. Each `searchCriteria` object should have `field`, `operator`, and `value` properties. Supported operators include 'like', 'is', 'not', 'contains', 'startsWith', 'between'. Example `searchCriteria`: `[{"field": "name", "operator": "contains", "value": "project"}]`.

request.description: Search and pagination parameters for filtering the list of saved filters. This can include `pageIndex`, `pageSize`, and `searchCriteria`.

example_uses: List all saved filters.
Show me saved filters that contain 'report' in their name, on page 2 with 10 items per page.
Can you find all saved filters related to 'partners'?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you want to list or search through the saved filters available to the current user.

endpoints.name: ApplySavedFilter
endpoints.description: Applies a saved filter by its ID and returns the corresponding filter request object, which can then be used to query data based on the saved criteria. Supports optional pagination parameters.

id.description: The unique ID of the saved filter to apply.

example_uses: Apply the saved filter with ID 123 and get its criteria.
Retrieve the filter configuration for 'My Sales Leads' filter.
Can you give me the filter request object for filter 456, setting page size to 20?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you want to retrieve the filter criteria defined in a saved filter to apply it to another data query or view.

endpoints.name: GetFilterStatistics
endpoints.description: Retrieves usage statistics related to saved filters, optionally filtered by entity type.

entityType.description: Optional filter to get statistics for a specific entity type (e.g., 'Project', 'Partner').

example_uses: Get overall usage statistics for all saved filters.
Show me the statistics for saved filters related to 'Project' entities.
How many times have users applied filters for 'Contact' entities?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to analyze the usage patterns or popularity of saved filters.
